title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran, to Be Known as the Naval National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Naval, Tỉnh Biliran được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Naval
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Naval, จังหวัด Biliran ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Naval

text.en: There is hereby established a public national high school in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Biliran, particularly in the Poblacion, to be known as the Naval National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
